text:
Situation: Cephalexin 500 mg capsules are not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 88 capsules (5 days at 17.5/day). Corvale General holds 399 capsules (26.5 days at 15.1/day). Corvale Lakeside holds 27 capsules (6.2 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1249914 at the repack plant Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC (FEI 3017450153) ended 2024-09-06 with a VAI classification. FDA’s shortage list does not include cephalexin as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Internal supply is unbalanced. East and Lakeside are below a two-week buffer. General has sufficient stock to support transfers without falling below two weeks. No national shortage is declared.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 157 capsules of 500 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Transfer 31 capsules of 500 mg from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
3. Evaluate purchase from AMELLA PHARMA, LLC if transfers are insufficient — requires buyer approval.
4. Evaluate purchase from AVKARE if transfers are insufficient — requires buyer approval.
5. Evaluate purchase from Ascend Laboratories, LLC if transfers are insufficient — requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or formulary substitutions at this time.
